title: Recognizing Events Is Not Enough: Why Streaming VLMs Struggle in Compositional Instruction Triggering
abstract: arXiv:2611.18743v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recognizing individual events does not guarantee correct execution of compositional instructions in streaming video. For example, given the request "Notify me when the pot boils after someone turns on the stove and leaves the kitchen", existing models may recognize the individual events yet notify too early or miss the intended moment, failing to track how their temporal conditions are satisfied over time. To evaluate this gap, we introduce CoTriggerBench, which composes annotated video events into temporally constrained instructions and verifies notification timing and silence through executable event plans and source-event replay. To address this challenge, we propose a real-time VLM agent, TEMPI. TEMPI decomposes instructions into atomic event queries and temporal constraints, and uses Scenario Memory to continuously maintain task progress as event evidence arrives, allowing earlier observations to support subsequent decisions beyon

translated_title: 识别事件还不够：为什么流式视觉语言模型在组合式指令触发中表现不佳
translated_abstract: 识别出单个事件并不保证在流式视频中正确执行组合式指令。例如，对于请求“在有人打开炉灶并离开厨房之后，当锅烧开时通知我”，现有模型可能识别出各个单独事件，却过早通知或错过预期的时刻，未能持续跟踪其时间条件如何随时间被满足。为评估这一差距，我们提出了CoTriggerBench，它将标注的视频事件组合成带有时间约束的指令，并通过可执行的事件计划和源事件回放来验证通知时机与保持静默的正确性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个实时VLM智能体TEMPI。TEMPI将指令分解为原子事件查询和时间约束，并利用场景记忆随事件证据的到来持续维护任务进展，使先前的观察能够支持后续的决策。
tldr: 该论文提出首个评估流式视频VLM在带时间约束的组合式指令触发能力的基准CoTriggerBench，并设计实时智能体TEMPI，通过将指令分解为原子事件查询并借助场景记忆持续跟踪任务进展，解决了现有模型过早或漏掉通知时机的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CoTriggerBench, the first benchmark evaluating streaming VLMs on compositional instruction triggering with temporal constraints, and proposes TEMPI, a real-time VLM agent that decomposes instructions into atomic event queries and uses Scenario Memory to continuously track task progress, fixing premature or missed notifications.
